# Locaweb Cloud DBaaS Provider

Customer DBaaS discovery and experimental catalog-qualified lifecycle through the CloudStack connector. Credential retrieval is an explicit ephemeral resource.

## Installation

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    dbaas = {
      source  = "locaweb/dbaas"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "dbaas" {}
```

Run `terraform init` or `tofu init`. Each CLI resolves `locaweb/dbaas` in its
own default registry.

## Authentication

The provider uses your Locaweb Cloud (CloudStack) customer API credentials.
Set `CLOUDSTACK_API_URL`, `CLOUDSTACK_API_KEY` and `CLOUDSTACK_SECRET_KEY`, or
select a CloudMonkey `config`/`profile`. Keep credentials out of configuration
files and version control. TLS verification is always enabled; `ca_file` only
adds trust roots.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Customer API key; defaults to CLOUDSTACK_API_KEY.
- `api_url` (String) CloudStack /client/api HTTPS URL; defaults to CLOUDSTACK_API_URL. HTTP is allowed only on loopback for development.
- `ca_file` (String) PEM certificate authorities added to the system trust store. TLS verification remains enabled.
- `config` (String) CloudMonkey INI path. Cannot be combined with explicit direct authentication.
- `http_get_only` (Boolean) Use signed GET instead of POST; defaults to CLOUDSTACK_HTTP_GET_ONLY, then false.
- `profile` (String) CloudMonkey profile (default cloudstack). Selecting a profile defaults the config path to ~/.cloudmonkey/config and excludes environment credentials.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Customer secret key; defaults to CLOUDSTACK_SECRET_KEY.
- `timeout` (Number) Operation wait limit in seconds; defaults to CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT, then 3600. Individual HTTP requests are limited to 30 seconds.
